events.title: Crochet Workshop: Hand Crochet Chunky Scarf

cases.refreshed: Mt. Pleasant Neighborhood Library will host a crochet workshop to create a chunky scarf. Adults of all skill levels are welcome. No registration is required. This event is first-come, first-served. Materials are limited to 8 participants. Provided materials include Bernat Jumbo and Chunky yarns for hand crochet. Participants are welcome to bring their own materials. Please park on nearby streets while the library shares the elementary school's parking lot.

events.title: Wacky Wednesdays: Coffee Filter Turkey Craft
